mapper.sql: select i.issue_id, i.project_id, p.project_name, i.provider, i.pr_number, i.fingerprint, i.first_task_id, i.first_run_id, i.last_task_id, i.last_run_id, i.issue_rank, i.severity, i.category, i.title, i.description, i.file_path, i.start_line, i.end_line, i.evidence, i.suggestion, i.origin, i.status, i.resolve_note, i.close_source, i.closed_by, i.closed_time, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time from review_issue i left join review_project p on p.project_id = i.project_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id
mapper.select: select issue_id, project_id, provider, pr_number, fingerprint, first_task_id, first_run_id, last_task_id, last_run_id, issue_rank, severity, category, title, description, file_path, start_line, end_line, evidence, suggestion, origin, status, resolve_note, close_source, closed_by, closed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_issue where project_id = #{projectId} and pr_number = #{prNumber} order by issue_rank asc, issue_id asc
select count(1) from review_issue where project_id = #{projectId} and origin = 'NEW' and status in ('AWAITING_CONFIRM', 'AWAITING_FIX')
mapper.insert: insert into review_issue (project_id, provider, pr_number, fingerprint, first_task_id, first_run_id, last_task_id, last_run_id, issue_rank, severity, category, title, description, file_path, start_line, end_line, evidence, suggestion, origin, status, resolve_note, close_source, closed_by, closed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{projectId}, #{provider}, #{prNumber}, #{fingerprint}, #{firstTaskId}, #{firstRunId}, #{lastTaskId}, #{lastRunId}, #{issueRank}, #{severity}, #{category}, #{title}, #{description}, #{filePath}, #{startLine}, #{endLine}, #{evidence}, #{suggestion}, #{origin}, #{status}, #{resolveNote}, #{closeSource}, #{closedBy}, #{closedTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update review_issue set last_task_id = #{lastTaskId}, last_run_id = #{lastRunId}, issue_rank = #{issueRank}, severity = #{severity}, category = #{category}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, file_path = #{filePath}, start_line = #{startLine}, end_line = #{endLine}, evidence = #{evidence}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, origin = #{origin}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where issue_id = #{issueId}

update review_issue set status = #{status}, resolve_note = #{resolveNote}, close_source = #{closeSource}, closed_by = #{closedBy}, closed_time = #{closedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where issue_id = #{issueId}
